text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I walk down the hallway, I come
across King
Halo and Fuji Kiseki chatting
together.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone gets together to dance? How
splendid!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If the idea tickles your fancy, would you
care to
join as well, my darling pony?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Really?! Why, I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, then let us enjoy ourselves
thoroughly on
the big day!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You there! Do come as well, should you
desire.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You'll find that the invitation is already...
in your
hand!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look at my hand and, sure enough, the
invitation
to the mysterious ball is right
there!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you've been invited to the ball as
well? Good
for you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You'll have the opportunity to witness
this social
butterfly's dancing with your
very own eyes!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Such delights don't come your way very
often, am
I right?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, I'm sure there'll be rumors
running
wild. "Who's that elegant lady
over there? Why, it
can only be..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Why the upward inflection? Say it with

conviction! "King!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I shall make sure all eyes are focused on
me when
I dance with Fuji at the ball!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But... if I'm going to perform alongside
Fuji, I
have to make sure I'm extremely
well prepared.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Don't act like it doesn't concern you!
Now that
you've been invited, you must
strive to be the
best you can be as well!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Start by changing your mindset. Now, try giving me some advice as to how I should begin.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmm, interesting.
choice_data_list: 視線を奪うダンスの特訓
究極の衣装を用意する
choice_data_list_en: Special dance training to captivate the crowd

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, the belle of the ball must
capture the
gaze of everyone in
attendance.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It is by wearing one's outfit with pride
and
dancing with the grace of a butterfly
that one
becomes first-rate. I see you've
done some
studying.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I must start my intense training at once!
Behold!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: SPLOSH!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Th-that's f-f-freezing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: King Halo's resolve is the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She pours water over herself to add
extra strain
on her body as she dances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She also frequents an amusement park
to learn
from the dancers in the parades.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: To maintain a smile and excellent posture even while wearing a heavy outfit... This is what I strive to achieve. But no, I must go further!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This continues over the course of a few
days...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What do you make of my magnificent
moves? I'm
not known as "first-rate" for
no reason, you know!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sleeves of her signature racewear
flutter like
the wings of a dancing
butterfly... She has
mastered the dance
style she's been longing for.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate outfit... Yes, those who are
first-rate
must stand at the summit of
fashion.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I must set off on a journey.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Project King

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mornings start early for King Halo. She
goes
through numerous books trying to
find inspiration
for the perfect dress.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Classical, yet eye-catching... Then it has
to be...
Yes, of course... This one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When one is first-rate, there can be no

compromise. She climbs a precarious
mountain
path to procure the ultimate
fabric from a
legendary weaver.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Who in the world... would think... to
live... in a
place like this?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Cough, splutter! There's so much dust...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In search of a famous dressmaker, she
charters a
boat to cross the seas.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, seriously now?! Does someone
actually live
here?!

text_block_list.name: Sailor
text_block_list.text: Haha! No, I'm just messin' with you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You've got to be kidding! No joking
around! Let's
go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After overcoming many hardships, King
Halo
finds her way home. The purpose of
her entire
journey was to obtain this
single outfit.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Well? How does it look? I got my
signature
racewear retailored to
perfection!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohoho! OHOHOHO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
King Halo's meticulous attention to
detail renders
me powerless to ask
what's changed about the
outfit. At any
rate, her hard work has paid off.
